difficulty: form-like page: label/value pairs in two side-by-side columns, plus a signature line drawn as a rule
title: Volunteer Registration Form
key_sentences: Please check the details below before you sign the form.
The details you give are used only to organise the volunteer rota.
By signing, you agree to follow the safeguarding guidelines of the centre.
Return the completed form to the reception desk.
notes: Two side-by-side column blocks, each with a level-2 heading and four 'Label: value' fields (label at left, value on a dotted rule). INTENDED READING ORDER: left column top to bottom, then right column top to bottom (the fields of one row are NOT a pair). Fields in order: 'Name: Ines Marwood'; 'Date of birth: 12 July 1991'; 'Phone: 0161 555 0142'; 'Email: ines.marwood@example.org' | 'Preferred role: Reading assistant'; 'Availability: Saturday mornings'; 'Start date: 2 May 2026'; 'Emergency contact: Tomas Marwood'. These are not a table and not a list (tables and list_items are empty); a scorer may check them as label/value pairs. The headings 'Personal details' and 'Volunteering' sit side by side at the same height. After the two sentences that close the body comes the signature line: the word 'Signature:' followed by a solid drawn rule (a border, no underscore characters) and, to its right, 'Date:' followed by another drawn rule; the date is blank. Furniture: 'Form VR-2, revised January 2026' at the bottom left of the page.
